title: Bates vs ConnCollege: tuition, size, location
summary: Bates College (Bates) versus Connecticut College (ConnCollege). Also searched as ConnCollege vs Bates. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Connecticut College and Bates College are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership codes reported by College Scorecard. Connecticut College, located in New London, has an undergraduate enrollment of 1,937 students, while Bates College in Lewiston enrolls 1,760 undergraduates. Tuition costs are similar, with Connecticut College charging $67,242 and Bates College $66,590 for in-state students. These differences reflect their distinct campus settings and enrollment sizes.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: Cost comparisons between Connecticut College and Bates College reveal similar tuition rates for both in-state and out-of-state students. Connecticut College charges $67,242 annually, while Bates College's tuition is slightly lower at $66,590. Despite these close tuition figures, the median debt for students completing their degrees differs notably. Graduates from Connecticut College carry a median debt of $23,500, which is significantly higher than the $14,275 median debt reported by Bates College graduates. These financial distinctions highlight varying student borrowing patterns at the two institutions.
